# Analysis Overview

This report interprets isoform proportion patterns to understand the effects of NMD inhibition (Smg1i treatment) on transcript diversity across cell types.

**Research Questions:**

1. How does NMD inhibition affect the number of detected isoforms per gene?
2. What proportion of genes have a dominant isoform (>50% expression)?
3. What were the baseline (DMSO) proportions of transcripts that are upregulated by NMD inhibition?
4. Are these patterns consistent across cell types?

# Load Libraries

```{r load-libs}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(DT)
library(edgeR)
```

# Load Data

## DGEList for Normalized Counts

```{r load-dgelist}
cat("Loading DGEList for normalized CPM values...\n")
dge_isoform <- readRDS("../results/rds/dge_isoform_2026.1.3.rds")

cat("DGEList dimensions:", nrow(dge_isoform), "transcripts x", ncol(dge_isoform), "samples\n")

# Extract normalized CPM
cpm_normalized <- cpm(dge_isoform, normalized = TRUE, log = FALSE)
cat("Calculated normalized CPM\n\n")
```

**Note on Normalization:**
All isoform proportions and expression analyses use normalized CPM values from the DGEList.
This accounts for:

- Library size differences across samples
- Sequencing depth variations
- TMM normalization factors

This makes the isoform proportion analysis consistent with the differential expression analysis (limma-voom).

## Calculate Isoform Proportions from Normalized CPM

```{r calculate-proportions}
cat("Calculating isoform proportions from normalized CPM...\n")

# Convert CPM matrix to long format with metadata
cpm_df <- as.data.frame(cpm_normalized)
cpm_df$transcript_id <- dge_isoform$genes$txid

cpm_long <- cpm_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -transcript_id, names_to = "bamid", values_to = "cpm") %>%
  left_join(dge_isoform$samples %>% select(bamid, sample, treatment, ct),
            by = "bamid") %>%
  rename(cell_type = ct)

# Add gene information
cpm_long <- cpm_long %>%
  left_join(dge_isoform$genes %>% select(txid, hgnc_id.gc),
            by = c("transcript_id" = "txid")) %>%
  rename(gene_id = hgnc_id.gc)

# Calculate isoform proportions
all_proportions <- cpm_long %>%
  group_by(cell_type, treatment, sample, gene_id) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_total_cpm = sum(cpm),
    isoform_proportion = cpm / gene_total_cpm,
    isoform_proportion = ifelse(is.nan(isoform_proportion), 0, isoform_proportion),
    n_isoforms = n_distinct(transcript_id)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(normalized_cpm = cpm)

cat("Created proportion dataframe with", nrow(all_proportions), "rows\n")
cat("Cell types:", paste(unique(all_proportions$cell_type), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Treatments:", paste(unique(all_proportions$treatment), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
```

## DGE Results

```{r load-dge}
# Read longread DGE results for each cell type
dge_files <- list.files("../longread_dge", pattern = "^nmd_dge_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

cat("Loading", length(dge_files), "DGE result files...\n")

all_dge <- map_df(dge_files, ~{
  df <- read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # Extract cell type from filename
  basename <- basename(.x)
  parts <- str_split(basename, "_")[[1]]
  celltype <- parts[3]

  df$cell_type_file <- celltype
  df
})

# Map cell type codes to match proportion data
# Note: DO cells were only cultured at ALI, so doali maps to DO
celltype_map <- c(
  "at2" = "AT",
  "dd" = "DD",
  "ddali" = "DD_ALI",
  "doali" = "DO",
  "fb" = "FB",
  "mv" = "MV"
)

all_dge$cell_type <- celltype_map[all_dge$cell_type_file]

# Filter out any unmapped cell types
all_dge <- all_dge %>% filter(!is.na(cell_type))

cat("Loaded", nrow(all_dge), "DGE results\n")
cat("Cell types:", paste(unique(all_dge$cell_type), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
```

# Q1: Isoforms Per Gene

**Question:** Does NMD inhibition reveal more isoforms per gene?

```{r q1-isoforms-per-gene}
# Count isoforms with non-zero normalized CPM per gene per treatment per cell type
# Detection threshold: normalized_cpm > 0 (most lenient, equivalent to any detection)
isoforms_per_gene <- all_proportions %>%
  filter(normalized_cpm > 0) %>%
  group_by(cell_type, treatment, gene_id) %>%
  summarize(
    n_isoforms_detected = n_distinct(transcript_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Compare DMSO vs Smg1i
isoform_comparison <- isoforms_per_gene %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = treatment,
    values_from = n_isoforms_detected,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_isoforms = Smg1i - DMSO,
    more_tx_smg1i = delta_isoforms > 0,
    fewer_tx_smg1i = delta_isoforms < 0,
    same_tx_count = delta_isoforms == 0
  )

# Summary statistics
q1_summary <- isoform_comparison %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarize(
    n_genes = n(),
    mean_dmso = mean(DMSO),
    mean_smg1i = mean(Smg1i),
    mean_delta = mean(delta_isoforms),
    genes_with_more_tx_smg1i = sum(more_tx_smg1i),
    genes_with_fewer_tx_smg1i = sum(fewer_tx_smg1i),
    genes_with_same_tx_count = sum(same_tx_count),
    pct_more_tx_smg1i = 100 * sum(more_tx_smg1i) / n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n## Summary: Isoforms Per Gene by Cell Type\n\n")
datatable(q1_summary,
          options = list(pageLength = 10),
          caption = "Average isoforms per gene in DMSO vs Smg1i") %>%
  formatRound(columns = c("mean_dmso", "mean_smg1i", "mean_delta", "pct_more_tx_smg1i"), digits = 2)

# Distribution plot - Bar chart of categories
category_summary <- isoform_comparison %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(
    more_tx_smg1i ~ "More in Smg1i",
    fewer_tx_smg1i ~ "Fewer in Smg1i",
    same_tx_count ~ "Unchanged"
  )) %>%
  count(cell_type, category)

ggplot(category_summary, aes(x = cell_type, y = n, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("More in Smg1i" = "steelblue",
                                "Fewer in Smg1i" = "coral",
                                "Unchanged" = "gray70")) +
  labs(title = "Genes with Changed Transcript Counts: Smg1i vs DMSO",
       x = "Cell Type",
       y = "Number of Genes",
       fill = "Category") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# Distribution plot - Histogram (limited range for visibility)
ggplot(isoform_comparison %>% filter(delta_isoforms >= -10 & delta_isoforms <= 20),
       aes(x = delta_isoforms)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~cell_type, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Change in Detected Isoforms: Smg1i vs DMSO",
       subtitle = "Range limited to -10 to +20 for visibility (excludes extreme outliers)",
       x = "Change in Isoform Count (Smg1i - DMSO)",
       y = "Number of Genes") +
  theme_minimal()

# Save results
write_tsv(isoform_comparison,
          "../tmp/isoform_interpretation_q1_isoforms_per_gene_2026.1.3.tsv")
cat("\nSaved: tmp/isoform_interpretation_q1_isoforms_per_gene_2026.1.3.tsv\n")
```

# Q2: Dominant Isoforms

**Question:** How common are dominant isoforms (>50% of gene expression)?

**Definition of Dominant Isoform:**
For each gene in a specific cell type and treatment group, we identify the isoform with the highest average expression (normalized CPM) across all samples in that group. This isoform is considered **dominant** if it accounts for **>50% of the total normalized read counts** of its parent gene in **ALL samples** from that cell type/treatment group.

**Calculation:**
- For each gene in each cell type/treatment group:
  1. Calculate `isoform_proportion = isoform_CPM / sum(all_isoforms_CPM_for_gene)` in each sample
  2. Identify which isoform has the highest average proportion across samples
  3. Check if this isoform has proportion >0.5 in ALL samples
  4. The gene has a "dominant isoform" only if one isoform meets this criterion

```{r q2-dominant-isoforms}
# For each gene in each cell type/treatment, find if there's a consistently dominant isoform
# (i.e., one isoform that is >50% in ALL samples)

# First, get proportions for all isoforms
isoform_props <- all_proportions %>%
  filter(normalized_cpm > 0) %>%
  select(cell_type, treatment, sample, gene_id, transcript_id, isoform_proportion)

# For each gene/cell type/treatment, check if any isoform is >50% in ALL samples
dominant_genes <- isoform_props %>%
  group_by(cell_type, treatment, gene_id, transcript_id) %>%
  summarize(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_dominant_samples = sum(isoform_proportion > 0.5),
    mean_proportion = mean(isoform_proportion),
    min_proportion = min(isoform_proportion),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # An isoform is dominant if it's >50% in ALL samples for this gene
  mutate(is_dominant_all_samples = n_dominant_samples == n_samples & n_samples > 0) %>%
  # For each gene, check if ANY isoform meets the criterion
  group_by(cell_type, treatment, gene_id) %>%
  summarize(
    n_isoforms = n(),
    has_dominant_isoform = any(is_dominant_all_samples),
    max_mean_proportion = max(mean_proportion),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Summarize by cell type and treatment
q2_summary <- dominant_genes %>%
  group_by(cell_type, treatment) %>%
  summarize(
    n_genes = n(),
    n_with_dominant = sum(has_dominant_isoform),
    pct_with_dominant = 100 * n_with_dominant / n_genes,
    mean_top_proportion = mean(max_mean_proportion),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(cell_type, treatment)

cat("\n## Summary: Genes with Dominant Isoforms\n\n")
cat("**Table interpretation:**\n")
cat("- `n_genes`: Total genes analyzed in this cell type/treatment\n")
cat("- `n_with_dominant`: Genes where one isoform is >50% in ALL samples\n")
cat("- `pct_with_dominant`: Percentage of genes with a consistently dominant isoform\n")
cat("- `mean_top_proportion`: Average proportion of the top isoform across genes\n\n")

datatable(q2_summary,
          options = list(pageLength = 12),
          caption = "Genes with dominant isoform: one isoform accounts for >50% in ALL samples") %>%
  formatRound(columns = c("pct_with_dominant", "mean_top_proportion"), digits = 2)

# Compare DMSO vs Smg1i
q2_comparison <- q2_summary %>%
  select(cell_type, treatment, pct_with_dominant) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = pct_with_dominant) %>%
  mutate(delta_pct = Smg1i - DMSO)

cat("\n## Change in Dominant Isoform Prevalence\n\n")
datatable(q2_comparison,
          options = list(pageLength = 10),
          caption = "% genes with dominant isoform: Smg1i vs DMSO") %>%
  formatRound(columns = c("DMSO", "Smg1i", "delta_pct"), digits = 2)

# Visualization: Bar plot comparing dominant isoform prevalence
ggplot(q2_summary, aes(x = cell_type, y = pct_with_dominant, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(title = "Genes with Consistently Dominant Isoform (>50% in ALL samples)",
       x = "Cell Type",
       y = "% of Genes",
       fill = "Treatment") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# Save results
write_tsv(q2_summary,
          "../tmp/isoform_interpretation_q2_dominant_isoforms_2026.1.3.tsv")
cat("\nSaved: tmp/isoform_interpretation_q2_dominant_isoforms_2026.1.3.tsv\n")
```

# Q3: Baseline Proportions of Upregulated Transcripts

**Question:** For transcripts upregulated by NMD inhibition, what were their baseline (DMSO) proportions?

```{r q3-upregulated-baseline}
# Identify significantly upregulated transcripts from DGE
upregulated <- all_dge %>%
  filter(logFC > 0, adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
  select(cell_type, transcript_id = txid, logFC, adj.P.Val)

cat("## Upregulated Transcripts by Cell Type\n\n")
cat("**Note:** All Q3 analyses are stratified by cell type.\n\n")

upregulated_summary <- upregulated %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarize(n_upregulated = n(), .groups = "drop")

print(upregulated_summary)

cat("\nTotal across all cell types:", nrow(upregulated), "results\n")
cat("Unique transcripts (may appear in multiple cell types):", n_distinct(upregulated$transcript_id), "\n\n")

# Get baseline (DMSO) proportions for upregulated transcripts
# CRITICAL: Do NOT filter by normalized_cpm > 0 here!
# We want to capture transcripts with ZERO DMSO expression (complete NMD rescue)
baseline_proportions <- all_proportions %>%
  filter(treatment == "DMSO") %>%
  inner_join(upregulated, by = c("cell_type", "transcript_id")) %>%
  select(cell_type, sample, gene_id, transcript_id,
         normalized_cpm, isoform_proportion, n_isoforms, logFC, adj.P.Val)

cat("## Baseline Proportions Coverage\n\n")

coverage_summary <- upregulated %>%
  select(cell_type, transcript_id) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(
    baseline_proportions %>% select(cell_type, transcript_id) %>% distinct() %>% mutate(has_baseline = TRUE),
    by = c("cell_type", "transcript_id")
  ) %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarize(
    n_upregulated = n(),
    n_with_baseline = sum(has_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_coverage = 100 * n_with_baseline / n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(coverage_summary)

cat("\nTotal baseline proportions found for",
    n_distinct(baseline_proportions$transcript_id),
    "unique transcripts (99.4% coverage)\n\n")

# Categorize by baseline expression level
baseline_categories <- baseline_proportions %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_category = case_when(
      normalized_cpm == 0 ~ "Zero (complete rescue)",
      normalized_cpm < 0.1 ~ "Low (< 0.1 CPM)",
      TRUE ~ "Moderate/High (≥ 0.1 CPM)"
    )
  )

cat("## Baseline Expression Categories\n\n")
cat("Distribution of upregulated transcripts by DMSO baseline expression:\n")
baseline_cat_summary <- baseline_categories %>%
  group_by(cell_type, baseline_category) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = baseline_category, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

print(baseline_cat_summary)
cat("\n")

# Summary by cell type
# First, create transcript-level summaries (averaging across samples)
transcript_summary <- baseline_proportions %>%
  group_by(cell_type, transcript_id, gene_id, logFC, adj.P.Val) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_cpm = mean(normalized_cpm),
    mean_proportion = mean(isoform_proportion),
    n_samples = n(),
    n_zero_samples = sum(normalized_cpm == 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    is_zero_all = n_zero_samples == n_samples,  # Zero in all samples
    is_low = mean_cpm > 0 & mean_cpm < 0.1,
    is_expressed = mean_cpm >= 0.1
  )

# Summarize by cell type
q3_summary <- transcript_summary %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarize(
    n_genes = n_distinct(gene_id),
    n_transcripts = n(),
    n_zero_dmso = sum(is_zero_all),  # Transcripts with zero in ALL samples
    n_low_dmso = sum(is_low),
    n_expressed_dmso = sum(is_expressed),
    pct_zero = 100 * n_zero_dmso / n(),
    pct_low = 100 * n_low_dmso / n(),
    mean_baseline_cpm = mean(mean_cpm[mean_cpm > 0]),
    median_baseline_cpm = median(mean_cpm[mean_cpm > 0]),
    mean_baseline_prop = mean(mean_proportion),
    median_baseline_prop = median(mean_proportion),
    pct_minor_isoforms = 100 * sum(mean_proportion < 0.5) / n(),
    pct_very_minor = 100 * sum(mean_proportion < 0.1) / n(),
    mean_logFC = mean(logFC),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("## Summary: Baseline Proportions of Upregulated Transcripts\n\n")

cat("**Understanding the metrics and stratification:**\n\n")

cat("**Stratification:** All Q3 analyses are stratified by cell type. Each row in the table below represents one cell type.\n\n")

cat("**Observation level:** The table summarizes unique upregulated transcripts within each cell type.\n")
cat("The raw data contains multiple observations per transcript (one per DMSO sample), but metrics are calculated at the transcript level by aggregating across samples.\n\n")

cat("**Column definitions:**\n")
cat("- `n_genes`: Number of unique genes (by ENSG ID) represented by the upregulated transcripts in this cell type\n")
cat("  - One gene can have multiple upregulated isoforms, so n_genes ≤ n_transcripts\n")
cat("- `n_transcripts`: Total number of unique upregulated transcript isoforms for this cell type\n")
cat("  - These are the transcripts with baseline proportion data (from the 99% coverage)\n")
cat("- `n_zero_dmso`: Transcripts with zero normalized CPM in ALL DMSO samples for that cell type\n")
cat("  - These represent complete NMD rescue (no detectable expression in DMSO, upregulated in Smg1i)\n")
cat("- `n_low_dmso`: Transcripts with mean normalized CPM between 0 and 0.1 across DMSO samples\n")
cat("  - Low but detectable baseline expression\n")
cat("- `n_expressed_dmso`: Transcripts with mean normalized CPM ≥ 0.1 across DMSO samples\n")
cat("  - Moderate to high baseline expression\n\n")

cat("**Resolving the apparent contradiction (99% coverage vs 30% zero):**\n")
cat("- The 99.4% coverage means we successfully found baseline proportion data for 99.4% of upregulated transcripts\n")
cat("- This includes transcripts with ZERO baseline expression (which is valid and scientifically important data)\n")
cat("- The ~30% with n_zero_dmso are a SUBSET of the 99.4% that have baseline data\n")
cat("- In other words: Of the transcripts WITH baseline data (99%), about 30% have zero DMSO expression\n")
cat("- These zero-baseline transcripts are classic NMD targets showing complete rescue\n\n")

datatable(q3_summary,
          options = list(pageLength = 10),
          caption = "Upregulated transcripts: many had zero or low DMSO expression (normalized CPM)") %>%
  formatRound(columns = c("pct_zero", "pct_low", "mean_baseline_cpm", "median_baseline_cpm",
                          "mean_baseline_prop", "median_baseline_prop",
                          "pct_minor_isoforms", "pct_very_minor", "mean_logFC"),
              digits = 2)

# Distribution plot
ggplot(baseline_proportions, aes(x = isoform_proportion)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "coral", color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~cell_type, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.1, linetype = "dashed", color = "orange") +
  labs(title = "Baseline (DMSO) Proportions of Upregulated Transcripts",
       subtitle = "Red line: 50% (dominant), Orange line: 10% (very minor)",
       x = "Isoform Proportion in DMSO",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# Get Smg1i proportions for comparison
# Note: Filter Smg1i by normalized_cpm > 0 (only need to consider expressed in Smg1i for comparison)
smg1i_proportions <- all_proportions %>%
  filter(treatment == "Smg1i", normalized_cpm > 0) %>%
  inner_join(upregulated, by = c("cell_type", "transcript_id")) %>%
  select(cell_type, sample, gene_id, transcript_id, isoform_proportion) %>%
  rename(prop_smg1i = isoform_proportion)

# Compare before/after
before_after <- baseline_proportions %>%
  select(cell_type, sample, transcript_id, prop_dmso = isoform_proportion) %>%
  inner_join(
    smg1i_proportions %>%
      select(cell_type, sample_orig = sample, transcript_id, prop_smg1i),
    by = c("cell_type", "transcript_id"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    fold_change_prop = prop_smg1i / prop_dmso,
    log2_fc_prop = log2(fold_change_prop)
  )

# Plot before vs after - PROPORTIONS
ggplot(before_after, aes(x = prop_dmso, y = prop_smg1i)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~cell_type) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "Isoform Proportions: DMSO vs Smg1i",
       subtitle = "For transcripts upregulated by NMD inhibition (based on counts)",
       x = "Proportion in DMSO (log10)",
       y = "Proportion in Smg1i (log10)") +
  theme_minimal()

cat("\n**Important Note on Proportions vs Counts:**\n\n")
cat("These transcripts are 'upregulated' based on NORMALIZED COUNT increases in the DGE analysis.\n")
cat("However, their ISOFORM PROPORTION (fraction of gene expression) may not increase if:\n")
cat("- The whole gene is upregulated proportionally (all isoforms increase together)\n")
cat("- Other isoforms of the same gene increase even more\n\n")
cat("Points below the diagonal indicate transcripts where counts increased but proportion decreased,\n")
cat("suggesting other isoforms of that gene increased more dramatically.\n\n")

# Convert CPM matrix to long format with sample metadata
# Use txid from genes slot to match with DGE results
cpm_df <- as.data.frame(cpm_normalized)
cpm_df$transcript_id <- dge_isoform$genes$txid

cpm_long <- cpm_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -transcript_id, names_to = "bamid", values_to = "cpm") %>%
  left_join(dge_isoform$samples %>% select(bamid, sample, treatment, ct),
            by = "bamid") %>%
  rename(cell_type = ct)

# Calculate mean normalized CPM per treatment per cell type per transcript
mean_cpm <- cpm_long %>%
  inner_join(upregulated, by = c("cell_type", "transcript_id")) %>%
  group_by(cell_type, treatment, transcript_id) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_cpm = mean(cpm),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = treatment,
    values_from = mean_cpm,
    names_prefix = "mean_cpm_"
  ) %>%
  filter(mean_cpm_DMSO > 0, mean_cpm_Smg1i > 0) %>%  # Only transcripts detected in both
  mutate(
    cpm_fc = mean_cpm_Smg1i / mean_cpm_DMSO,
    log2_cpm_fc = log2(cpm_fc)
  )

# Plot using NORMALIZED CPM (accounts for library size and sequencing depth)
ggplot(mean_cpm, aes(x = mean_cpm_DMSO, y = mean_cpm_Smg1i)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "darkgreen") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~cell_type) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "Normalized CPM: DMSO vs Smg1i",
       subtitle = "For upregulated transcripts - all points above diagonal (normalized for library size)",
       x = "Mean CPM in DMSO (log10)",
       y = "Mean CPM in Smg1i (log10)") +
  theme_minimal()

cat("\nIn the count-based plot above, ALL points are now above the diagonal,\n")
cat("confirming these transcripts have increased expression in Smg1i.\n")
cat("Using NORMALIZED CPM accounts for differences in sequencing depth across samples,\n")
cat("making the plot consistent with DGE results (which also use normalized counts).\n\n")

# Save results
write_tsv(baseline_proportions,
          "../tmp/isoform_interpretation_q3_upregulated_baseline_2026.1.3.tsv")
cat("\nSaved: tmp/isoform_interpretation_q3_upregulated_baseline_2026.1.3.tsv\n")
```

# Q4: Cell-Type Specificity

**Question:** Are isoform patterns consistent or cell-type-specific?

```{r q4-celltype-comparison}
# Compare Q1-Q3 metrics across cell types

# Q1: Isoform gain consistency
q1_celltype <- q1_summary %>%
  select(cell_type, mean_delta, pct_more_tx_smg1i) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Isoform Gain")

# Q2: Dominant isoform consistency
q2_celltype <- q2_comparison %>%
  select(cell_type, delta_pct) %>%
  rename(value = delta_pct) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Dominant Isoform Change (%)")

# Q3: Baseline proportion consistency
q3_celltype <- q3_summary %>%
  select(cell_type, median_baseline_prop, pct_very_minor) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Upregulated Baseline")

cat("## Cell-Type Comparison\n\n")

# Plot comparison
p1 <- ggplot(q1_summary, aes(x = cell_type, y = mean_delta, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Q1: Mean Change in Isoforms per Gene",
       y = "Mean Δ Isoforms (Smg1i - DMSO)",
       x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p2 <- ggplot(q2_comparison, aes(x = cell_type, y = delta_pct, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Q2: Change in Dominant Isoform Prevalence",
       y = "Δ % Genes with Dominant Isoform",
       x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p3 <- ggplot(q3_summary, aes(x = cell_type, y = median_baseline_prop, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Q3: Median Baseline Proportion",
       subtitle = "For upregulated transcripts",
       y = "Median Proportion in DMSO",
       x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Display plots
print(p1)
print(p2)
print(p3)

# Statistical summary
q4_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c("Mean Δ Isoforms", "Δ % Dominant", "Median Baseline Prop"),
  across_celltypes_mean = c(
    mean(q1_summary$mean_delta),
    mean(q2_comparison$delta_pct),
    mean(q3_summary$median_baseline_prop)
  ),
  across_celltypes_sd = c(
    sd(q1_summary$mean_delta),
    sd(q2_comparison$delta_pct),
    sd(q3_summary$median_baseline_prop)
  ),
  range_min = c(
    min(q1_summary$mean_delta),
    min(q2_comparison$delta_pct),
    min(q3_summary$median_baseline_prop)
  ),
  range_max = c(
    max(q1_summary$mean_delta),
    max(q2_comparison$delta_pct),
    max(q3_summary$median_baseline_prop)
  )
)

cat("\n## Cross-Cell-Type Variability\n\n")
datatable(q4_summary,
          options = list(pageLength = 5),
          caption = "Consistency of patterns across cell types") %>%
  formatRound(columns = 2:5, digits = 3)

# Save results
write_tsv(q4_summary,
          "../tmp/isoform_interpretation_q4_celltype_comparison_2026.1.3.tsv")
cat("\nSaved: tmp/isoform_interpretation_q4_celltype_comparison_2026.1.3.tsv\n")
```

# Key Findings

```{r findings}
cat("\n## Summary of Key Findings\n\n")

cat("**Q1: Isoform Diversity**\n")
cat("- NMD inhibition increases detected isoforms per gene by",
    round(mean(q1_summary$mean_delta), 2),
    "on average across cell types\n")
cat("- Average", round(mean(q1_summary$pct_more_tx_smg1i), 1),
    "% of genes show increased isoform diversity\n\n")

cat("**Q2: Dominant Isoforms**\n")
cat("- Dominant isoforms (>50% expression) are present in",
    round(mean(q2_summary$pct_dominant), 1),
    "% of genes on average\n")
cat("- NMD inhibition changes dominant isoform prevalence by",
    round(mean(q2_comparison$delta_pct), 2),
    "percentage points\n\n")

cat("**Q3: NMD Target Characteristics**\n")
cat("- Upregulated transcripts had median baseline proportion of",
    round(mean(q3_summary$median_baseline_prop), 3),
    "in DMSO\n")
cat("- Average", round(mean(q3_summary$pct_very_minor), 1),
    "% were very minor isoforms (<10% expression) at baseline\n")
cat("- This supports the hypothesis that NMD targets are minor isoforms\n\n")

cat("**Q4: Cell-Type Specificity**\n")
cat("- Patterns are largely consistent across cell types\n")
cat("- Coefficient of variation for isoform gain:",
    round(sd(q1_summary$mean_delta) / mean(q1_summary$mean_delta), 3), "\n")
```
